description.zh: 树形结构的一张图：位置自动排、也能拖开，能折叠、能缩放，能一键复制成 Markdown / Mermaid / OPML
description.en: A tree laid out for you — and you can drag any node aside: collapse, pan, zoom, copy it as Markdown, Mermaid or OPML

help.zh: 底栏那三颗复制按钮占地方。卡片很窄的时候先把它们收起来，需要复制了再回来取消这个开关。
help.en: The three copy buttons take up room in the bottom bar. Hide them when the card is narrow, and turn this back off when you want to copy again.

tools.name: draw
tools.description: Replace the whole map with an indented outline: one node per line, leading spaces set the depth.

tools.name: append
tools.description: Attach an indented outline under a node. `under` is an exact node text; leave it out to hang the outline off the root.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Report the node count, the depth, and the outline itself when it is short enough to return.

title.en: One line is enough to start

items.zh: 空卡片中间那颗按钮建出根节点，光标直接落在里面。打完按回车就存下。
items.en: The button in the middle of an empty card creates the root and puts the cursor in it. Enter keeps what you typed.

items.zh: 回车会顺手加一个兄弟节点，所以一路回车就能列下去；Tab 是往下一层，Shift+Tab 提回来。
items.en: Enter also adds a sibling, so you can keep typing down the list; Tab goes one level deeper and Shift+Tab comes back up.

items.zh: 位置是排出来的：改从属关系不用挪任何东西，整张图自己重排。嫌哪里挤，拖开就行，那个位置会记住。
items.en: The layout places the nodes, so changing what hangs off what reflows everything by itself. Want more room? Drag a node aside and that spot is kept.

items.zh: 方向键上下在树里前后走，← 折叠（已经折叠了就回父节点），→ 展开（已经展开了就进第一个孩子）。
items.en: Up and down walk the tree; Left collapses (or goes to the parent when already collapsed), Right expands (or enters the first child).

items.zh: Tab 加子节点、Shift+Tab 把这一支提一级、Alt+↑↓ 和旁边的兄弟换位置、Delete 删掉整棵子树。
items.en: Tab adds a child, Shift+Tab promotes the branch, Alt+Up/Down swaps it with a sibling, Delete removes the subtree.

items.zh: F2 或回车改名字，Esc 退出编辑。中文输入法选词时按回车不会多出一个节点。
items.en: F2 or Enter renames, Esc leaves editing. Typing with an IME: Enter picks the word instead of adding a node.

items.zh: 每个框都能拖：按住、走超过一点点才算拖，它下面的整支跟着一起走。连线会跟着框跑——拖只改位置，不改谁挂在谁下面。
items.en: Any node can be dragged: hold and move past a few pixels, and its branch comes along. The links follow the boxes — a drag moves a node, never re-parents it.

items.zh: 纵向会吸到行上，按住 Alt 就不吸（想微调的时候用）。拖到一半按 Esc 弹回原处，松手之后 Ctrl+Z 退回上一次拖动。
items.en: Up and down snaps to the rows; hold Alt to place it freely. Press Esc mid-drag to put it back, or Ctrl+Z after letting go to undo that drag.

items.zh: 自动排还是底：加一个兄弟节点，被拖过的那个会跟着自己那行一起往下走。assistant 整张重画时，所有摆位都会清掉。
items.en: Auto layout is still the base: add a sibling and a dragged node moves down with its row. When the assistant redraws the map, the spots are cleared.

items.zh: 叶子多了图会很高，这是右向生长的代价。折叠是最快的解法：选一支，按一下 ←。
items.en: Many leaves make a tall map — that is the price of growing rightwards. Collapsing is the quickest fix: select a branch, press Left.

items.zh: 空白处拖动是平移，滚轮也是；Ctrl 加滚轮（或触控板捏合）是缩放。底栏那颗方框按钮把整张图装回卡片。
items.en: Drag empty space to pan, or use the wheel; Ctrl with the wheel (or a pinch) zooms. The square button in the bar fits the whole map back in.

items.zh: 折叠的节点右边会写一个 +N，那是它底下藏了多少个。折叠只影响看，不影响导出。
items.en: A collapsed node shows +N for how much it is hiding. Collapsing changes the view, never the export.

items.zh: 底栏三颗按钮把整张图复制成 Markdown 大纲 / Mermaid / OPML，粘到你想要的地方就行。卡片里没有「另存为」——沙箱不让下载文件。
items.en: The three buttons copy the map as a Markdown outline, Mermaid or OPML; paste it wherever you need it. There is no Save as here — the sandbox does not allow downloads.

items.zh: 复制需要「写入剪贴板」这一项权限。没授权的时候按钮点了会明说「没复制成功：剪贴板权限没开」，不会默默没反应。
items.en: Copying needs the write-clipboard permission. Without it the card says the copy failed and names the permission instead of silently doing nothing.

items.zh: 长节点在卡片里会被省略号截断，但复制出去的是全文。
items.en: Long nodes get an ellipsis in the card; what you copy is the whole text.

items.zh: 跟它说「把发布流程拆成五步」，它按缩进文本一次画出来。同一句话跑两次，排出来的一模一样。
items.en: Ask it to break a release flow into five steps and it draws them from an indented outline. The same sentence twice gives the same map.

items.zh: 它要么整张替换，要么往某个节点下面挂一支；两种情况 Ctrl+Z 都是一步退回。
items.en: It either replaces the whole map or hangs a branch under a node; either way one Ctrl+Z takes it back.

items.zh: 这条能力要单独授权（属性面板里那行 Agent tool calls）。不给它，它画不进来。
items.en: This needs its own permission — the Agent tool calls row in the inspector. Without it, nothing can be drawn in.

changes.zh: 每个节点都能拖开：整支子节点跟着走，连线跟着框，纵向吸到行上（按住 Alt 不吸）。
changes.en: Every node can be dragged aside: its branch comes along, the links follow, and it snaps to the rows unless you hold Alt.

changes.zh: 拖动只改位置，不改从属关系；一次拖动算一步撤销，Esc 中途取消。
changes.en: Dragging only moves a node, never re-parents it; one drag is one undo step, and Esc cancels mid-drag.

changes.zh: 摆位会存下来（关掉重开还在），但自动布局仍是底——加兄弟节点时它会跟着自己那行走。
changes.en: The spot is saved across restarts, but auto layout stays the base: add a sibling and it moves down with its own row.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：缩进大纲画成右向生长的树，位置自动排、改结构不用挪框。
changes.en: First release: an indented outline becomes a rightward-growing tree, laid out automatically.

changes.zh: 折叠、平移、缩放；键盘两态（编辑 / 选中），中文输入法选词时的回车不算提交。
changes.en: Collapse, pan and zoom; two keyboard modes (editing and selected), and an IME's Enter does not count as a commit.

changes.zh: 整张图能复制成 Markdown / Mermaid / OPML；assistant 能一句话生成，一次调用算一步撤销。
changes.en: The whole map copies out as Markdown, Mermaid or OPML; the assistant can draw one in a sentence, one undo step per call.
